notes.general_comments:
The questions for which most candidates selected the correct answer were 9, 11, 13, 17, 19, 21, 24, 26, 27
and 29. These questions were answered correctly by 60 per cent or more of the candidates. They covered
different parts of the syllabus and were set to test different skills.
The questions for which the fewest candidates selected the correct answer were 6 and 15. These questions
were answered correctly by fewer than 25 per cent of the candidates.
